description:
## Problem
On `next`, docs/benchmarks/tpc-di.md says the reference tables are smaller than the specification's and lists 'TradeType 6 (5)', which is larger; the FactMarketHistory sentence says 'about two years of trading days times 800 securities gives about 584,800', but 584800 / 800 = 731 calendar days. The specification figures quoted there (about 1,500 brokers per unit, DimDate 1950-2021, 541,550 rows) were not verified.

## Change
Fix the two sentences against core develop and the TPC-DI specification; verify each quoted specification figure against the specification text or remove it.

## Decision gates
None for wording fixes. `next` only; nothing goes to `main`.

## Verification rubric
Pass: each number on the page has a source recorded in the PR body (core file and line, or specification clause); `npm run lint:docs` and `npm run docs:check` pass.

## Additions from the item review
- Site `main` docs/benchmarks/tpc-di.md line 73 already says the reference tables, TradeType included, are smaller; v0.5.1 has 6 trade types (`benchbox/core/tpcdi/financial_data.py`). By the owner's decision of 2026-11-20 only `next` is corrected; `main` is left alone.
- Verify the scale-range statements #178 added for TSBS DevOps, VectorSearch, MetadataPrimitives, FlightData and JoinOrder by constructing each class at core develop; they were not verified.

## Guardrails (owner, 2026-11-20)
Accepted by the owner in the choice dialog: the agent never posts a stand-in review, closes and reopens a pull request to restart CI, uses `--no-verify`, force-pushes, rewrites an author, or deletes anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`. It arms with `make pr-arm` once per pull request and reports the result. Subagents are read-only. Any limit, default, threshold or label text is shown to the owner before it is committed. A blocked step stops this item; the agent moves to the next item and does not work around the block.
Review threads: the accepted text also said the agent never resolves a thread. Asked afterwards which rule applies, the owner chose: "The morning rule: I may resolve a thread once the bot has reviewed the new head and did not raise the finding again." ('I' is the agent.) So the agent pushes the fix and replies, and resolves a thread only after the bot's review of the new head does not raise that finding again.
